mainEntity.name: Should I manage the remodel myself or hire a general contractor for my rental property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a general contractor for your rental property remodel is generally recommended for efficiency and quality, especially for significant projects. A general contractor manages all aspects, including hiring subcontractors, scheduling, materials procurement, and ensuring compliance with building codes. This saves you time and stress, and their expertise can prevent costly mistakes. While self-managing might seem cost-effective for very small projects, the complexity and time commitment of larger renovations often outweigh the potential savings, making a contractor a valuable investment for landlords.
acceptedAnswer.description: For significant renovations, hiring a general contractor is usually more efficient and prevents issues, as they manage all project aspects. Self-managing is only advisable for very small projects.
